column1: # Census version 9: one line per entry of the archived table with 3<=d<=32, N<=1024 (make_numbers_v9.py).
# verdict: strict | local (strictness open) | nonstrict | notlocal | flex (no local minimum within delta, resolved) | unresolved (delta < 1e-12 or set by h) | equalcontact_notlocal | none

# certificate: strict_iso, strict_hyper (recognition, version 8), strict_recog9 (recognition at higher degree, version 9), strict_sym, strict_exact, strict_new, strict_above, strict_second (second-order criterion), local, nonstrict_split, notlocal_flat, notlocal_flat_above, notlocal_descent, notlocal_nonopt, flex (version 8 radius), flex_cut9 (radius of the intrinsic cut), flex_unres, none_size, failed
# tier (positive verdicts): A = dist_ls <= 1e-12 and code_inside_rho; B = dist_ls <= 1e-12 otherwise; C = dist_ls > 1e-12

# c_lo_30, c_hi_30: integers; the certified cosine (of the zero of the square system) lies in [c_lo_30, c_hi_30] * 10^-30. dist_ls: certified least-squares distance to the stored code, modulo rotations, on the non-rattlers (local minima: plus the tube). rho, kappa_half: the radius and growth rate kappa/(2 sqrt d) of Theorem 3.9 (isostatic) or of the hyperstatic certificate; code_inside_rho: the stored code lies within rho (exact decision).

# close_call: the first pass's gap to the nearest non-contact pair is below 1e-9; double_cert: the larger contact graph is certified as well (paper_v8/recount/tolscan_close.jsonl); double_cert_dist: an upper bound for the distance between the two certified configurations (sum of their distances to the stored code).

# tau_prime, h: version 8 negative certificate; delta_v8, delta_cut: radius on the grid and at the intrinsic cut (exact; empty if not searched or not decided); delta: the version 9 radius; resolved: 1 if delta >= 1e-12 and set by the separation.

# field_degree: degree of the field of the exact description (strict entries described exactly). live_cos: displayed cosine on 7 November 2026; live_lower: 1 if below the archived displayed cosine; live_author: 1 if the live table credits the entry to the author. note: further exact results (prestress9.py).
